log_gap.title: Marcos — torn page
log_gap.body: A night with no entry. Margin ink: do not trust the posted list. Try the leftover numbers on 91.0.

search_negro.title: Search the Negro mouth
search_negro.body: HQ and the desk both point downriver. Unfold the map — Rio Negro mouth / quiet anchorage.

map_negro_mouth.title: Quiet anchorage
map_negro_mouth.body: Boat report: blackwater meeting silt, an unmarked hold. Someone left a folded slip: Marcos was here after 'reassignment.'

map_negro_rapids.title: Cache at the portage
map_negro_rapids.body: A marker in the brush. Half a log page in Marcos's hand — he was moving upriver, not rotating out.

town_rumor.title: Called upriver
town_rumor.body: Porangatu still asks when Marco comes back. HQ's rotation story does not reach town.

condor_missed.title: Condor overdue
condor_missed.body: Survey Team Condor missed a sched. Last words point at the eastern channel. Challenge if they call: SIERRA.

search_east.title: Search the eastern channel
search_east.body: Unfold the map — Channel bend / stranger camp. Condor hung a grid mark there.

map_east_bend.title: Condor grid
map_east_bend.body: Channel bend matches Condor's last grid. Their evening pad may still be live on 103.0.

map_bend_camp.title: Stranger camp
map_bend_camp.body: Survey stakes above the bend. Not Army issue. Questions about old paths.

condor_grid.title: Grid seven-four-niner
condor_grid.body: Condor's last position. Cross with the eastern channel landing if you can spare batteries.

code_sierra.title: Code word — SIERRA
code_sierra.body: If a weak Condor voice challenges you, answer SIERRA.

code_bravo.title: Code word — BRAVO
code_bravo.body: The quiet net uses BRAVO. Army will not thank you for knowing it.

search_village.title: Upstream village
search_village.body: A shaman is asking for medicine, not politics. Map: Rio Negro fork — upstream village.

map_negro_village.title: Village will talk
map_negro_village.body: Elders share a herb path if you keep their name off the military net. Call them on 94.8.

map_bend_landing.title: Trader code
map_bend_landing.body: Chalk on a post at Bend do Sapo. The river still watches the water.

map_east_wharf.title: Quiet relay post
map_east_wharf.body: Schedules scratched for boats that never log with HQ. A night window, unlisted.

map_manaus_wharf.title: Unlisted night window
map_manaus_wharf.body: Wharf chatter: a window near the Negro mouth. Army wants it logged. Someone else wants BRAVO.

coded_window.title: Not the posted list
coded_window.body: A careful voice: after midnight, not the posted frequencies. Be careful who you serve.

reassignment_story.title: Routine?
reassignment_story.body: HQ says Marcos was reassigned upriver. The dates and the empty chair disagree.

bend_strangers.title: Strangers at the bend
bend_strangers.body: Not military — not river. Asking about old paths. The shaman wants herbs, not an audience.

shaman_ask.title: Herbs and medicine
shaman_ask.body: The village needs fever bark and clean bandages. This is a supply ask, not a recruitment.

clean_channel.title: Clean channel
clean_channel.body: Net Control: routine traffic only. Unverified civilian bands are 'not your problem.'
